proposal.title: Designer layout proposal
proposal.description: Furnish the empty bedroom with a modest queen bed and catalog-evidenced wardrobe. Bed head against solid upper wall, away from window; wardrobe against lower wall left of bed to leave the entrance and both bed sides accessible. Budget unconfirmed. Total catalog cost 389000 AMD, mock prices not shop quotations. Solar orientation and door-sweep clearance unverified.

proposal.description: Reading starter set with an upholstered armchair beside the window and bookcase backed against the nearby solid wall, facing inward. Existing pieces retained unchanged. Budget unconfirmed; catalog mock prices total 137000 AMD, not a shop quotation. Solar orientation and door-sweep clearance unverified because north and swings are unknown.
